Both PTYs received input. App 1 PTY TX is 10 bytes: 'll' CR 'ls -la' CR; RX shows 'zsh: command not found: ll' and a root directory listing. App 2 PTY TX is 21 bytes: '===' plus eight DEL bytes and CR, then 'uname -a' CR; RX shows the Darwin 25.5.0 DEBUG_ARM64_T8103 arm64 uname line. Both apps report input_unsent_bytes 0 and errors [].

No host-origin input: the VUART TX is exactly 337 bytes (challenge plus the one launcher line in desktop-input.bin), the writer was sealed, keyboard_command_sent and terminal_input_enabled are false, and no PDSerialHID text appears. In this configuration the 31 PTY bytes did not come from host input.
The kernel logged 'first device-1 input report accepted by IOHID' and 'first dev2 input submitted to passive child' during the session, between DL23_DESKTOP_PID and the console return.
Frames/commits are 8/8 (app 1) and 11/11 (app 2); both terminals ended at 80x23.
The capture has no per-keystroke timestamps, so 'at the same time' rests on Chris's account; the capture shows both terminals took input while both were alive.

conclusion: Human-witnessed use of two simultaneously running Chonkstep shared-Shell terminals on the M1's built-in panel, with native-keyboard commands in both, corroborated by the capture's two independent PTY input streams and outputs, sealed host input, kernel first-report logs, complete cleanup, text-console return and verified Linux recovery.
